name: Brian Schimpf
current_role: Co-founder and CEO of Anduril Industries
summary: Brian Schimpf spent about a decade as an engineer at Palantir, finishing as a director of engineering, before co-founding the defense company Anduril in 2017 with Palmer Luckey and others; he has run it as CEO since its founding while Luckey serves as the public face.
